It lies in the main ridge of the mountain. It has two peaks, the main southern (1,596 m above sea level) and a few meters lower north (1,593 m above sea level). The peaks are luminous, providing an undisturbed circular view. The slopes of Ostredok are smoothly modeled, steep, in winter there is a danger of avalanche dropping.
The 49 km long Great-Frontier Highway is marked by the red tourist sign marked with a red tourist mark. [1]
In Slovakia there are up to six hills called Ostredok. [2] [3]
